text_block_list.text:
We've come to summer camp, where
racers train
extra hard to get better. It's
important that Seiun
Sky improves
significantly in the run-up to the
Kikuka
Sho. Speaking of Sky...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course I am! This is summer camp,
ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's the gentle yet harsh place that's
perfect for
runners who wanna improve!
In other words...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We're at the sea! There's fishing! This is
my
chance to catch a fish I've never laid
eyes on
before!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Look, I even brought a field guide!
There are
some pretty cool creatures in
the waters here. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Training," you say? Not sure I know that
word.
choice_data_list: トレーニングも頑張ろうな
トレーニングも頑張ろうね
choice_data_list_en: Let's do our best with training, too.
Let's do our best with training, too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm kidding. You know I get it. ☆ Don't worry, I'll train too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tons of different racers come to camp,
which
means it's the perfect place to
gather
information. And most
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe and the others are here.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've got plenty of time—to catch
my first
fish, that is! No, my first ten!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That rocky cliff over there looks
promising! Let's
go check it out. ♪

And with that, my spirited(?) summer
camp
experience with Seiun Sky begins.
